# Synthetic FEMIC hydrology response fixture

A synthetic `femic.hydrology.response.v1` bundle for the FHOPS P15.1/P15.2
contract tests. It contains one domain, one watershed, one receptor, one
response surface, one flood-risk table, and ready validation/model-card
evidence.

The fixture is not a real watershed, gauge record, flood model, or regulatory
product. All values are synthetic.
